title: A plain default connect is the native wire in its most efficient mode

cases.purpose: A connect that names only host (and port, when the runner could not bind the default) uses the PDB native wire, protocol 2 multiplexed -- asserted by the SERVER, not by the client's own belief.
steps: Open a connection with the SDK's documented zero-option entry point (JDBC: DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:particledb://HOST:PORT/") with no properties).
Run SHOW pdb.wire_protocol on that connection.

cases.purpose: The default connect negotiates every capability the server offers that changes efficiency or correctness: multiplexing, server-side prepared statements, typed and array parameters, per-entry batch SQLSTATEs, statement notices and per-value numeric scale.
steps: SHOW pdb.wire_capabilities (comma-separated, sorted names of the bits the server ECHOED in HELLO_OK).
cases.expected: Contains every name in required_capabilities. An SDK that does not implement bulk ingest may omit bulk_ingest, and must say so in its results file as a note on this case.

cases.purpose: Results arrive as binary Arrow IPC, not text.
What the SDK believes it negotiated equals what the server recorded -- a client-side assertion that cannot be satisfied by a client that silently fell back.
steps: Read the SDK's own view of the negotiated protocol and capability set (JDBC: PdbConnection.negotiatedProtocol() / negotiatedCapabilities()).
cases.expected: Identical protocol string and identical capability set.

cases.purpose: The SDK's default port is the SERVER's default native-wire port (PDB_CONF_DEFAULT_PORT: the runner reads it from the server binary, never from this file), and a connect that omits the port reaches a server listening there.
steps: Assert the SDK's default-port constant equals PDB_CONF_DEFAULT_PORT.
If the runner's server listens on that port (PDB_CONF_PORT == PDB_CONF_DEFAULT_PORT), connect WITHOUT a port and run SHOW pdb.wire_protocol.
cases.expected: Constant equals PDB_CONF_DEFAULT_PORT; the port-less connect reports 'pdb-native-v2'. When the runner could not bind the default port the second half is skipped with that reason (the first half still runs).

cases.purpose: Parameterised statements are executed as server-side prepared statements by default (bound parameters, never interpolated text).
steps: Execute SELECT $1::text || '' with the parameter  o'clock; DROP TABLE x --  through the SDK's parameterised API ten times.
Ask the SDK whether the statement ran server-prepared (JDBC: PdbPreparedStatement.isServerPrepared()).
cases.expected: Every execution returns the parameter byte-for-byte, and the SDK reports the statement as server-prepared after its prepare threshold. (Server side: DEF-002 asserts the prepared capability was negotiated.)

cases.purpose: The server observable cannot be forged: SET of pdb.wire_protocol is refused.
cases.expected: SET answers 55P02; the value is unchanged.
